title: Analytics event taxonomy (.gamestudio/analytics/*.taxonomy.json)
description: The analytics contract: every event the game sends, its trigger, typed parameters and the KPIs it feeds. event_taxonomy.py generates a first draft from the contract and emits engine stubs from this file. Names are snake_case and kept within the limits common to Firebase / GA4 (names up to 40 characters, starting with a letter, no reserved prefixes firebase_, google_, ga_; at most 25 parameters per event); verify current platform limits before launch.

param_name.description: snake_case parameter name, starts with a letter, at most 40 characters, no reserved prefixes.

type.description: Value type. Use string for ids and enums, int for counts and money in minor units, float for durations and ratios, timestamp for epoch milliseconds.

required.description: Whether every occurrence must carry the parameter (stubs assert it in debug builds).

enum.description: Optional closed list of allowed values (keeps cardinality low).

naming.description: Naming convention for events and parameters; always "snake_case".

common_params.description: Parameters attached to every event by the analytics wrapper (e.g. session_id, build, ab_cohort). They count toward the per-event parameter limit.

events.description: Every event the game sends. Event names must be unique.

name.description: Event name in snake_case (object_action order recommended, e.g. "level_start"). Prefer GA4 recommended game event names where they fit (level_start, level_end, tutorial_begin, tutorial_complete, earn_virtual_currency, spend_virtual_currency).

category.description: Event family; dashboards group by it.

trigger.description: Exact moment the event fires, precise enough to implement and test, e.g. "results screen shown after the last wave".

kpis.description: KPIs or funnels this event feeds, e.g. "d1", "ftue_funnel", "level_win_rate", "arpdau_usd".

sampling.description: Optional client-side sampling rate for high-volume events (1.0 = every occurrence).
